ai_analysis.scouting_notes: Hellebuyck is one of the NHL's premier franchise goaltenders. His 2024-25 season reflects elite command of the crease, combining size, patience, tracking, and technical consistency. He plays a calm, economical game, rarely chasing unnecessary movement and consistently giving Winnipeg a chance to control low-scoring games. His profile projects as a top-tier NHL starter and award-level goaltender, with the main evaluation note being whether his regular-season dominance can consistently translate into deeper playoff success.
